title: Don’t Forget to Turn Back Your Clocks! ⏰
description:
🕒 Daylight Saving Time Ends tomorrow, Sunday, Nov. 2! 

Remember to set your clocks back by one hour and enjoy an extra hour of rest. 💤

Also it's a great time to check and replace the batteries in your smoke and carbon monoxide detectors for your safety!

#daylightsaving #sandiego
